sentences.A: In January, Bankman-Fried pleaded not guilty to all counts, which include wire fraud, conspiracy to commit money laundering and conspiracy to misuse customer funds.
sentences.B: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
sentences.C: The Raiders were abysmal on the offensive side of the ball, outside of a second-quarter touchdown drive led by Josh Jacobs.
sentences.D: Hồi tháng 1, Bankman-Fried đã không nhận tội với mọi cáo buộc, gồm gian lận chuyển tiền điện tử, âm mưu rửa tiền và âm mưu lạm dụng tiền của khách hàng.
